Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL2163183. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard type IC50, exact standard relation '=', and non-null pChEMBL value. Require compound_structures as an INNER JOIN. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
